title: PgDog is funded and coming to a database near you
summary: PgDog, a high-performance PostgreSQL connection pooler written in Rust, announced its seed funding round. The project aims to provide a faster and more modern alternative to existing connection poolers like PgBouncer, with focus on performance and ease of deployment.
problem_solved: Provides high-performance PostgreSQL connection pooling to efficiently handle thousands of concurrent database connections while reducing server load.
why_valuable: With growing cloud-native and distributed applications requiring efficient database connection management, PgDog offers significant performance improvements over traditional solutions while maintaining simplicity.
